governance: identity frozen — ids never change meaning and are never deleted; governed by GOVERNANCE.md exactly as the taxonomy is
respectful_modeling: No entity kind, relation kind or attribute here encodes a person's protected traits or any inference about behavior drawn from them. A proposal adding one is refused under this rule, not weighed.

entity_kinds.label: Person
entity_kinds.definition: An individual human being, identified as a named individual.

entity_kinds.label: Organization
entity_kinds.definition: A body of people with a collective identity that can act, hold offices and have members: a company, public agency, school district, board, association, coalition or party.

entity_kinds.label: Market (priced tradable)
entity_kinds.definition: A publicly priced tradable treated as an actor because its price or implied probability is observed: a trading pair, instrument or prediction-market contract. Not an industry, sector or geographic sales territory.

entity_kinds.label: Role (office)
entity_kinds.definition: A formally defined position within exactly one organization that exists independently of whoever holds it and may be vacant, such as the superintendent of a school district or a numbered board seat. Not an informal function, disposition or characterization of a person.

relation_kinds.label: holds office
relation_kinds.definition: The person occupies the role for a period. Tenure is the claim's own period; absence of valid_to means not stated, never ongoing.

relation_kinds.label: office of
relation_kinds.definition: The role is a position within the organization.

relation_kinds.label: member of
relation_kinds.definition: The person or organization belongs to the organization as a member, or as staff when no position is recorded. A position that persists independently of its holder is a role, stated with holds-office.

relation_kinds.label: reports to
relation_kinds.definition: The first role is formally accountable to the second. Reporting lines join offices, not people; who reports to whom follows through holds-office.

relation_kinds.label: governs
relation_kinds.definition: The first organization holds formal authority, conferred by law, charter or bylaws, to direct or oversee the second.

relation_kinds.label: vendor to
relation_kinds.definition: The first organization supplies goods or services to the second under an agreement.

relation_kinds.label: knows
relation_kinds.definition: The two people are acquainted. Says nothing about the nature, closeness or privacy of the acquaintance.

relation_kinds.label: allied with
relation_kinds.definition: The two parties are aligned on a named public matter.

relation_kinds.label: opposes
relation_kinds.definition: The first party takes a stated position against the second on a named public matter. Not personal animosity.

relation_kinds.label: competes with
relation_kinds.definition: The two parties contend for the same contract, office, customers or other contested outcome.
